app.title: Metalcor Autopeças
app.subtitle: Procurement (procure-to-pay)
app.fictionalNotice: Study project. Companies, names and data are fictional.

nav.label: Navigation
nav.recentEmpty: No requisitions created in this session.
nav.recentNote: Only requisitions created in this browser session appear here (the API has no listing yet).
nav.dashboardNotice: The dashboard is aimed at management (manager, finance and approver), but the read-only data is open to every role.

lookup.title: Find document
lookup.textNotSupported: Searching by text number (e.g. PR-2026-000973) is not possible yet: the API has no such endpoint. Use the numeric ID.
lookup.note: Temporary limitation: lookup works by numeric ID only.

login.title: Sign in as
login.intro: Pick a user to explore the system. There is no sign-up and no password.

home.tasksIntro: Three tasks to walk through the procurement flow, from requisition to payment.
home.task1Text: Sign in as Requester and create a purchase requisition with one or more items.
home.task2Text: Sign in as Buyer (or Approver, depending on the amount-based rule). Use "Find document", in the sidebar, with the requisition number from step 1 to open it, approve it and issue the purchase order.
home.task3Title: 3. Receive, invoice, pay and see the SQL
home.task3Text: Sign in as Finance, open the order through document lookup, and register the goods receipt, the invoice and the payment. Then open the Dashboard with technical mode on to see the SQL behind each number.

new.title: New purchase requisition
new.intro: Fill in the header and the items. The requisition is created as a draft.
new.requesterOnly: Only the Requester role creates requisitions. Switch user to continue.
new.limitation: Temporary limitation: plants, cost centers, materials and units come from a static copy of the sample data, because the API has no endpoints for these master data yet.

detail.title: Requisition
detail.submitHelp: The requisition is a draft. Submit it to start the approval.
detail.decisionHelp: The amount-based rule defines who can decide; if your role is not the required one, the API refuses.
detail.commentRequired: A comment is required when rejecting.
detail.issueHelp: Requisition approved. Issue one purchase order per supplier.
detail.ordersLimitation: This list only shows now; after a reload, the API has no way yet to list the orders of a requisition.

form.title: Register goods receipt
form.help: Enter the quantity received for each item. Items with an empty or zero quantity are ignored.
form.invalidQuantity: Use numeric quantities, no negative values.
form.noItems: Enter the quantity of at least one item.

form.title: Register invoice
form.help: Values start equal to the order and can be edited. Items with an empty or zero quantity are left out.
form.financeOnly: Only the Finance role registers invoices; the API refuses other roles.
form.dueHelp: Without a due date, the API uses the invoice date plus the supplier's payment terms.
form.dueBeforeInvoice: cannot be before the invoice date
form.invalidLine: enter a valid quantity and price (price greater than zero)
form.noItems: Enter the quantity of at least one item.

detail.blocked: Invoice blocked by the three-way match
detail.linkLimitation: Temporary limitation: the API returns only the order number, not its ID, so the source order is not a link.
detail.alreadyPaid: This invoice has already been paid.
detail.approveHelp: Approves despite the three-way match exception. The justification is optional.
detail.payHelp: Creates the payment and marks the invoice as paid.
detail.financeOnly: Only the Finance role can do this; the API refuses other roles.

payment.title: Payment
payment.linkLimitation: Temporary limitation: the API returns only the invoice number, not its ID, so the source invoice is not a link.

dashboard.title: Manager dashboard
dashboard.intro: Numbers and charts for the procurement flow. Turn on technical mode, in the header, to see the SQL behind each one.

spendByMonth.title: Spend by month
spendByMonth.description: Total order value per month, stacked by material category.

exceptionSummary.title: Exceptions by type
exceptionSummary.description: Invoices with a three-way match exception, open x released.

latePayments.title: Late payments by month
latePayments.description: Total late payments and average days late of the late ones.

supplierScorecard.title: Supplier ranking
supplierScorecard.description: On-time delivery rate and invoice exception rate, ordered by total spend.

staleInvoices.title: Stale invoices
staleInvoices.description: Invoices blocked for more than 45 days by a three-way match exception.

errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check that the API is running and try again.
errors.badRequest: The data sent is not valid.
errors.unauthorized: User not recognized. Switch user and try again.
errors.forbidden: Your role cannot perform this action.
errors.notFound: We could not find this record.
errors.conflict: This action is not possible in the document's current state.
errors.server: The server ran into a problem. Please try again later.

validation.headline: Fix the fields below and try again.
validation.paymentMethod: choose bank transfer, boleto or pix
